messages:
claire: Quick follow-up on the PM: need owners for (1) global panic toggle, (2) automated rollback, (3) rollout metrics/backfill. Prefer short deadlines.

 tom: I'll own the panic toggle + runbook. Simple HTTP endpoint + console action. Proto by end of week.

 anika: I'll own rollout metrics and dashboards. Will emit `rollout_pct`, `flag_error_rate_5m`, `flag_p95_10m`. ETA: 4d.

 sree: I'll do auto-rollback. Plan: require 2 signals (error_rate & p95) sustained for 3m. Draft config:
```
rollback_policy:
  require: 2
  signals:
    - name: error_rate_5m
      threshold: 0.05
    - name: p95_latency_10m
      threshold_ms: 1500
  sustained_secs: 180
```
I'll add CI behavioral tests. ETA: 10d.

 infra-bot: incident-bot: linked postmortem #1107 -> https://redwood/postmortems/1107. Attach follow-ups there.

 claire: I'll add action items to the tracker: panic (tom) 1w, metrics (anika) 4d, rollback (sree) 10d, quarterly audit recurring. Sync Tue 09:30 to confirm API contracts. Please comment if dates need moves.

 tom: adding runbook steps to tracker. Also request: include a gauge metric "active_rollout_pct" so we can backfill incident impact.

 anika: noted, will emit minute-level histogram for 48h to help backfills.

 sree: I'll include an optional safelist for exempt customer IDs so critical traffic isn't auto-rolled back.

 claire: great, thanks all. infra-bot remind us to link PRs to postmortem when ready.
